LIC16 - License - Users never logged on
STA11 - Start here - Events over time
SYS11 - System - Event Log

variables.Event Header: =[TimeOrdered]+[Event ID]+[Start datetime]+[Application Type]+[Server]+[Cluster]+[Object Type]+[Object ID]+[Error]+[Action ID]+[Cluster]+[Datetime Recorded in Database]+[Error]+[Event Category]+[Event Type]+[Object]+[Object Folder Path]+[Session ID]+[Tenant]+[User]+[Top Level Folder]+[Status]+[Status Code]+[Status Description]
variables.TimeOrdered: =Year([Start datetime])+" "+(If (MonthNumberOfYear([Start datetime])<10) Then ("0"+MonthNumberOfYear([Start datetime])) Else MonthNumberOfYear([Start datetime]) )+ " "+ (If (DayNumberOfMonth([Start datetime])<10) Then ("0"+DayNumberOfMonth([Start datetime])) Else DayNumberOfMonth([Start datetime]) )+ " "+(FormatDate([Start datetime];"HHmmss"))

/BI Platform Auditing.name: SYS12 - System - Delay in Recording of events to Audit Database
SYS13 - System - Overall System Load Analysis (without Mode)
SYS13 mis - System - Overall System Load Analysis inc Mode
SYS14 mi - System -  Refresh Analysis (Mode is Interactive)
SYS14 mis- System -  Refresh Analysis (inc Mode)
SYS14 ms - System -  Refresh Analysis (Mode is Scheduled)
SYS15 - System - Platform Services Log

variables.Status:
=If ([Object Type]="Server") Then (
If ([Property]="DISABLED_TARGET") Then (If [Property Value]="1" Then [Object]+" Disabled" Else [Object]+" Enabled")
ElseIf ([Property]="EXPECTED_RUN_STATE") Then (If [Property Value]="1" Then [Object]+" Started" Else [Object]+" Stopped")
ElseIf ([Property]="AUTOBOOT") Then ([Object]+" Started on boot up")
ElseIf ([Property]="REQUIRES_RESTART") Then ([Object]+" Modified and requires restarting")
)
Else If ([Object Type]="Auditing Configuration") Then (If ([Property]="AUDIT_DB_CONNECTION") Then ("Auditing Connection Updated")
ElseIf ([Property]="DISABLED_AUDIT_EVENT_DETAILS") Then ("Auditing Events Disabled")
ElseIf ([Property]="ENABLED_AUDIT_EVENTS") Then ("Auditing Events Enabled")
ElseIf ([Property]="AUDIT_LEVEL") Then (" Auditing Level Changed to "+[Property Value]))
